answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Every claim climbs the tundra of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the raven re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The falcon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
